// CASE dart_worker_interp_extra expect=fire
Future<List<R>> a<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T, String) operation, Future<String> Function(T) label) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index], '${await label(items[index])}');
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_interp_sibling expect=fire
Future<List<R>> b<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation, Future<String> Function(T) label) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = pick(await operation(items[index]), '${await label(items[index])}');
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_ternary_extra expect=fire
Future<List<R>> c<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation, Future<R> Function(T) fallback, bool ok) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = ok ? await operation(items[index]) : await fallback(items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_nested_closure_await expect=fire
Future<List<R>> d<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T, Future<void> Function()) operation, Future<void> Function(T) audit) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index], () async { await audit(items[index]); });
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_dup_comment_quote expect=fire
Future<List<R>> e<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = pick(await operation(items[index]) /* it's */, await operation(items[index]), 'x');
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_honest_comment_apostrophe expect=pass
Future<List<R>> f<T, R>(List<T> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(/* don't "await" twice */ items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_honest_formatted expect=pass
Future<List<R>> g<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(width, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(
          // it's the only await here
          items[index],
        );
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<R>();
}
// CASE dart_worker_cast expect=pass
Future<List<R>> h<T, R>(List<Object?> items, int width, Future<R> Function(T) operation) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(List.generate(width, (_) async {
    while (next < items.length) {
      final index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index] as T);
    }
  }));
  return results.cast<R>();
}
